title: b7z9.12.1: C desync FSM header declarations and Kconfig gate
description: Add lichen_desync_state enum and lichen_desync_on_* function declarations to link.h or a new desync.h header. Gate behind CONFIG_LICHEN_TDMA_DESYNC Kconfig. The implementation already exists in tdma.c:82-142 but lacks public declarations.
close_reason: Premise stale — satisfied by landed code: the desync FSM public declarations already exist in lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/link.h:236-294 (enum lichen_desync_state, lichen_desync_on_sfn_wrap/on_beacon/on_missed_superframe with doc comments), inside the existing #ifdef CONFIG_LICHEN_TDMA gate, and the implementation in tdma.c is likewise gated (CONFIG_LICHEN_TDMA, which Kconfig documents as including 'desync FSM per 2a.5'). A separate CONFIG_LICHEN_TDMA_DESYNC knob would add configuration granularity with no consumer — declined per simplicity bias. FSM behavior is vector-tested by lichen/tests/desync_fsm and tdma_guard_budget (beads b7z9.12.3-slice/b7z9.12.5 closed).
